recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle. Days 1-13 covered early money bugs, a WhatsApp notification chase, a huge solo admin-dashboard build, a full admin design/Realtime consolidation, a 44-field settings rebuild that mostly didn't save at first, an analytics page rebuild, badge cards shipping (and breaking, and getting fixed) across all six bots, and a five-leak memory hunt on the API server. Day 13 (July 1, 2026) closed the badge saga with a WhatsApp-specific image URL/format fix. Day 14 (also July 1, 2026) closed out the memory-hardening pass: three more leak sources patched, then a deep review turned up six correctness bugs including a race condition risking a duplicate refund/commission/badge. Day 15 (July 3-4, 2026) shipped free in-house support ticketing across all six bots by reusing the dispute system's chat/notification pipes instead of paying for a CRM, then spent the next ten hours fixing what broke: a silently-failing SLA-reminder cron (missing DB column), an admin reassign-modal crash, and attachment-only messages failing with no error to the user.
